class.name: VehicleAppearance
class.brief_description: What a kind of vehicle looks like.
class.description: The models it is drawn with: the exterior, the low-poly interior, the passengers and the attachments, their skins and where they sit in the vehicle's frame. Shared by every vehicle of the kind and handed to its kind's renderer ([VehicleRenderingServer]); a kind of vehicle's appearance derives from it with the submodels its renderer turns ([RailVehicleAppearance], [RoadVehicleAppearance]).

members.member: Models drawn with the exterior, in its frame and with its skins.
